title: What's the matter with them? What must they do?
translation: 他们怎么啦？他们该怎么办？
description: A bilingual lesson about people's illnesses (headache, earache, toothache, stomach ache, temperature, flu, measles, mumps) and what they must do, with workbook practice on joining sentences with so/because and short answers, plus grammar on must/mustn't. 关于各种疾病（头痛、耳痛、牙痛、胃痛、发烧、流感、麻疹、腮腺炎）以及病人必须做什么的双语课程，配合教材 so/because 连句和简短回答练习，以及 must/mustn't 的语法练习。
answer_note: Workbook answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 62 key; Practice B questions 4-6 ask for personal information (dentist's name, doctor's name, telephone number) and the supplied key gives the pattern only. Textbook written-exercise A answers are constructed from the printed examples and labelled suggested. Grammar answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 62 grammar key (PDF pages 479-480); in grammar II.8 the key prints the alternatives 'you/we mustn't'. No external sources were used.

lines.text: So she must take an aspirin.
lines.translation: 所以她必须吃一片阿司匹林。

lines.text: So he must see a doctor.
So he must see a dentist.
So she must take some medicine.
So he must go to bed.
So he must stay in bed.
So we must call the doctor.
So we must call the doctor.

lesson.text: Listen to the tape and answer the questions.

41st She has a headache. So she must take an aspirin.

52nd George has an earache. So he must see a doctor.

63rd He has a toothache. So he must see a dentist.

74th Jane has a stomach ache. So she must take some medicine.

85th Sam has a temperature. So he must go to bed.

96th Dave has flu. So he must stay in bed.

107th Jimmy has measles. So we must call the doctor.

118th Susan has mumps. So we must call the doctor.
lesson.translation:
第41位 她头痛。所以她必须吃一片阿司匹林。

第52位 乔治耳痛。所以他必须去看医生。

第63位 他牙痛。所以他必须去看牙医。

第74位 简胃痛。所以她必须吃些药。

第85位 萨姆发烧。所以他必须上床睡觉。

第96位 戴夫得了流感。所以他必须卧床。

第107位 吉米得了麻疹。所以我们必须请医生。

第118位 苏珊得了腮腺炎。所以我们必须请医生。

items.title: take an aspirin
items.text: 相当于 have an aspirin，服(吃)一片阿司匹林。

practice.title: A So and because
practice.instruction: Join the sentences with the word so - and then with the word because. 分别用 so 和 because 来连接以下各组句子。
practice.translation: Join each pair of sentences with so, then with because.
practice.context: Each item gives both the so-sentence and the because-sentence, in that order. Item 1 is a printed example and is not editable.

questions.prompt: I have a temperature. / I must go to bed.
questions.answer:
I have a temperature, so I must go to bed.
I must go to bed because I have a temperature.

questions.prompt: You have flu. / You must stay at home.
questions.answer:
You have flu, so you must stay at home.
You must stay at home because you have flu.

questions.prompt: She has a toothache. / She must see a dentist.
questions.answer:
She has a toothache, so she must see a dentist.
She must see a dentist because she has a toothache.

questions.prompt: He has a bad headache. / He must take an aspirin.
questions.answer:
He has a bad headache, so he must take an aspirin.
He must take an aspirin because he has a bad headache.

questions.prompt: You have measles. / We must call the doctor.
questions.answer:
You have measles, so we must call the doctor.
We must call the doctor because you have measles.

questions.prompt: I have a stomach ache. / I must take some medicine.
questions.answer:
I have a stomach ache, so I must take some medicine.
I must take some medicine because I have a stomach ache.

practice.title: B About you
practice.instruction: Answer these questions with full sentences. 用完整的句子回答以下问题。
practice.translation: Answer each question in a full sentence about yourself.
practice.context: The supplied key gives model answers: 1 No, I don't often have a cold or a headache. 2 Yes, I sometimes have a stomach ache. 3 No, I don't often have a toothache. 4-5 My dentist's/doctor's name is Mr./Mrs. ...... and his/her telephone number is ...... 6 I must stay in bed and call a doctor.

questions.prompt: Do you often have a cold or a headache?
questions.answer: No, I don't often have a cold or a headache.

questions.prompt: Do you sometimes have a stomach ache?
questions.answer: Yes, I sometimes have a stomach ache.

questions.prompt: Do you often have a toothache?
questions.answer: No, I don't often have a toothache.

questions.prompt: What's your dentist's name and telephone number?
questions.answer: My dentist's name is Mr./Mrs. ...... and his/her telephone number is ......

questions.prompt: What's your doctor's name and telephone number?
questions.answer: My doctor's name is Mr./Mrs. ...... and his/her telephone number is ......

questions.prompt: Imagine: you have mumps or measles! What must you do?
questions.answer: I must stay in bed and call a doctor.

grammar.title: I. Make sentences according to the example. 仿照例句造句。
grammar.instruction: Make sentences according to the example. 仿照例句造句。
grammar.translation: Make must/mustn't sentences from the given cues, following the example.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=494
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example and is not editable. The exercise continues on grammar PDF page 192.

questions.prompt: you/tell the truth/lies
questions.answer: You must always tell the truth. You mustn't tell lies.

questions.prompt: I/be early for school/late
questions.answer: I must always be early for school. I mustn't be late.

questions.prompt: we/drink clean water/dirty water
questions.answer: We must always drink clean water. We mustn't drink dirty water.

questions.prompt: he/put on a clean shirt/dirty one
questions.answer: He must always put on a clean shirt. He mustn't put on a dirty one.

questions.prompt: she/drink milk/beer
questions.answer: She must always drink milk. She mustn't drink beer.

questions.prompt: you/go out in the fresh air/stay at home
questions.answer: You must always go out in the fresh air. You mustn't stay at home.

questions.prompt: they/speak English/Chinese
questions.answer: They must always speak English. They mustn't speak Chinese.

questions.prompt: we/remember the telephone number/forget it
questions.answer: We must always remember the telephone number. We mustn't forget it.

questions.prompt: you/study first/watch television after school
questions.answer: You must always study first. You mustn't watch television after school.

questions.prompt: the children/play in the garden/on the banks of a river
questions.answer: The children must always play in the garden. They mustn't play on the banks of a river.

grammar.title: II. Give short answers to the questions according to the examples. 仿照例句简短回答下列问题。
grammar.instruction: Give short answers to the questions according to the examples. 仿照例句简短回答下列问题。
grammar.translation: Give short must/mustn't answers to each question.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=495
grammar.context: Items 1 and 6 are printed examples and are not editable. Item 8 accepts you/we per the key.

questions.prompt: Must a woman have new clothes? (yes)
questions.answer: Yes, she must.

questions.prompt: Must I finish this homework before the lesson? (yes)
questions.answer: Yes, I must.

questions.prompt: Must he do all the work today? (yes)
questions.answer: Yes, he must.

questions.prompt: Must you go now? It's only eight o'clock. (yes)
questions.answer: Yes, I must.

questions.prompt: Must I type the letter now? (yes)
questions.answer: Yes, you must.

questions.prompt: Must she stay in bed? (no)
questions.answer: No, she mustn't.

questions.prompt: Must they go to bed late? (no)
questions.answer: No, they mustn't.

questions.prompt: Must we tell him the news? (no)
questions.answer: No, you/we mustn't.

questions.prompt: Must I walk across the street? (no)
questions.answer: No, you mustn't.

questions.prompt: Must he take an aspirin? (no)
questions.answer: No, he mustn't.

grammar.title: III. Answer the questions, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词回答下列问题。
grammar.instruction: Answer the questions, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词回答下列问题。
grammar.translation: Answer each what's-the-matter question using the given cue.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=495
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example and is not editable. The exercise continues on grammar PDF page 193. Items 3 and 8 accept he/she per the key.

questions.prompt: What's the matter with Bob? He looks ill. (have a cold)
questions.answer: He has a cold.

questions.prompt: What's the matter with you? (have a bad headache)
questions.answer: I have a bad headache.

questions.prompt: What's the matter with our teacher? (feel ill)
questions.answer: He/She feels ill.

questions.prompt: What's the matter with your son? (have a temperature)
questions.answer: He has a temperature.

questions.prompt: What's the matter with Susan? (have a bad toothache)
questions.answer: She has a bad toothache.

questions.prompt: What's the matter with them? (have mumps)
questions.answer: They have mumps.

questions.prompt: What's the matter with you? (have a stomachache)
questions.answer: I have a stomachache.

questions.prompt: What's the matter with the baby? (be thirsty)
questions.answer: He/She is thirsty.

questions.prompt: What's the matter with John? (have measles)
questions.answer: He has measles.

questions.prompt: What's the matter with your sister? (have an earache)
questions.answer: She has an earache.
